title: Future Juice Cereal & Milk 10ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Cereal & Milk is a classic breakfast-inspired blend that captures the familiar taste of golden, crunchy Cereal soaked in creamy Milk. The malty sweetness of toasted Cereal brings a comforting depth, while the smooth, milky undertones recreate the satisfying flavour of a fresh bowl of cereal enjoyed to the last drop. The result is a nostalgic and well-balanced vape that’s perfect for any time of day. This nic salt e-liquid is formulated to provide a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. With a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, it offers consistent flavour and subtle vapour production—perfect for pod kits, vape pens, and beginner devices. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this 10ml e-liquid suits vapers looking for anything from light to stronger nicotine intake. Future Juice is a UK-based brand dedicated to producing bold, satisfying flavours by combining classic profiles with modern twists, delivering high-quality e-liquids made for everyday vaping enjoyment.
